title: Experiments
summary: A fair test of what works, for one person, before it goes into a manual.

stories.want: to find out which way of breaking a fast suits me
stories.soThat: I decide from my own results, not my mood on the day

requirements.text: An experiment compares two to four options.
Unless the user chose to pick, the app picks the next option: the one with the fewest trials.
What counts as better (ratings, diary numbers) is fixed when the experiment is set up.
The rating for a trial is asked for `experiment.rate-after` after it.
A fasting experiment opens a trial by itself when a fast ends.
When enough trials are in, the coach writes up the result and, if it held, carries it into the manual it was about.
